sentences: [CHANNEL NAME], what is this quantum physics nonsense?
One electron. Two gaps. It went through both.
visual: Deadpan host at a lab bench, a double-slit rig behind. Chalkboard: "DOUBLE-SLIT EXPERIMENT".

sentences: I can't even get through one door without hitting the frame.
visual: Host walks into the lab door frame. Bonk. Door sign: "LAB".

sentences: Fire paintballs at a wall with two slits, and you get two stripes.
Makes sense.
Nobody's crying.
visual: Paintball turret fires; two neat splat stripes build up on the back wall. Range sign: "ROUND 1: PAINTBALLS".

sentences: But water waves make many stripes.
Where peaks meet, waves grow.
Where a peak meets a dip, they cancel.
That's an interference pattern.
visual: Ripples spread from two gaps and overlap; a striped band shows on the far wall. Sign: "ROUND 2: WAVES"; label "INTERFERENCE PATTERN" appears on its name.

sentences: Then scientists fired electrons, one at a time.
Each one lands as a single dot, like a tiny bullet.
visual: Electron in sunglasses struts out of an electron gun. One dot on the screen. Sign: "ROUND 3: ELECTRONS"; counter "FIRED: 1".

sentences: But thousands of dots build the stripes.
One electron, alone, interfering with itself.
Like using both doors of a shop and meeting yourself at the till.
visual: Counter races to 10 000 as the dots build stripes. Cutaway gag: electron at a shop till meets itself.

sentences: Scientists got suspicious and put a detector at the slits.
The pattern vanished.
Two boring stripes.
visual: A detector swings in at the slits, "DETECTOR ON" light. The electron sweats. The screen shows only two stripes.

sentences: You see, the detector has to interact with the electron to record its slit.
Once that record exists, the pattern's gone.
visual: Close on the detector writing "SLIT: LEFT" on its readout as the electron passes.

sentences: Camera or coffee cup, it makes no difference.
'Observer' doesn't mean a person.
visual: Host points along the bench: camera, coffee cup, clipboard. Each has a "DETECTOR" tag.

sentences: So until you measure it, the electron acts like a spread-out wave of possibilities.
Measure it, and you get one answer.
visual: The electron spreads into a glowing wave cloud through both slits, then snaps to one dot on "one answer".

sentences: Electrons are particles, waves, and drama queens.
visual: Host deadpan; the electron in sunglasses beside him strikes a pose. Camera comes to rest.
